name: Sudan
summary: Drone strikes on civilians at record levels; RSF commander defected on 31 Oct
state: Strikes on a market and homes in RSF-held Nyala on 26 Oct killed more than 100 people according to the rights group Emergency Lawyers; medical groups gave lower figures. The UN says drones are now the leading cause of civilian deaths, and El Obeid remains under RSF pressure. A senior RSF commander, Siddiq Ander, announced his defection on 31 Oct. No ceasefire talks were under way as of 2 Nov.
for_you: Sudan is the world's largest displacement crisis. Aid agencies report severe funding shortfalls.
rubric_hit: Massacres and sieges reported (Nyala, El Obeid) = Alert

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
